ActorTalk: Every new semester, I stand here for a bit. Just watching the new F.O.S. cadets get their bearings.
It's a strategic assessment. It helps me plan the next steps for the semester.
If there's a promising group, I can afford to delegate more. If they're particularly hopeless, I know I'll have to find some way to get them up to speed.
I don't need your commentary, thank you.
Isn't it obvious...? Well, I suppose that's not entirely true...
In all that time, there was only one person I read completely wrong.
Not that it means my judgment is off. Everyone else I've acknowledged has measured up exactly as expected.
They've proven it where it counts. On the field.
That's very dedicated of you, Vanessa.
Can you really tell all that just by looking?
